name: Neuer Berliner Kunstverein (n.b.k.)
known: Directors: Lucie Schauer from 1975 to 1994, Alexander Tolnay from 1995 and Marius Babias from 2008 (German Wikipedia).

name: SAVVY Contemporary: The Laboratory of Form-Ideas
known: Bonaventure Soh Bejeng Ndikung was artistic director until 2022, Renan Laru-an from 2023 to 2025.
Lema Sikod and Lynhan Balatbat-Helbock are now executive directors (SAVVY website).
Wikipedia calls Ndikung the founding director of SAVVY Contemporary and says he was to take over the Haus der Kulturen der Welt (HKW) in Berlin on 1 January 2023.
The board page of SAVVY friends e.V., the space's friends' association, names him as founder and chairperson of SAVVY Contemporary.
Its chairman is the artist Thomas Eller Wang and its treasurer is Wolfgang von Dallwitz.

name: transmediale
known: The 2026 edition, the 39th, ran from 28 January to 1 February 2026 at silent green Kulturquartier (Gerichtstraße 35) and CANK (Karl-Marx-Straße 95), curated by Neema Githere and Juan Pablo García Sossa (e-flux).
Artistic directors: Andreas Broeckmann (2001 to 2007), Stephen Kovats (from 2007), Kristoffer Gansing (from 2012) and Nóra Ó Murchú (from 2021, departure announced in July 2024) (Wikipedia).

name: Kunsthalle Bielefeld
known: Joachim Wolfgang von Moltke was the first director (Wikipedia).

name: Kunstverein Bielefeld
known: Victoria Tarak is director.
The Vorstand is Andreas Wannenmacher (chair), Audrey Hörmann (deputy chair), Fabian Kauczok (treasurer), Prof.
Board chair Andreas Wannenmacher.

name: Bonner Kunstverein
known: Founders included the painters Paul Magar, Gerhard Neumann and Ernemann Sander, and the first chairman was the journalist Thankmar von Münchhausen (German Wikipedia).
Director: Viktor Neumann, since spring 2025.
Earlier directors were Margarethe Jochimsen (1978 to 1986), Annelie Pohlen (1986 to 2004), Christina Végh (2005 to 2015), Michelle Cotton (2015 to 2019) and Fatima Hellberg (2019 to 2025) (website).

The December 2006 renovation of the Blumenhalle was started with money from the benefit auction "Der Kunst ihre Räume" under director Christina Végh and supplemented by city funds; the Atelierhaus studios are city-supported (German Wikipedia).
The board is chaired by Dr.
Anke Schierholz, with Gisela Clement as vice chair and Thomas Weppelmann as treasurer (website).

name: Kunstverein Braunschweig
known: The architect Peter Joseph Krahe, a founder of its predecessor the Verein der Kunstfreunde, was its first chair from 1834 and active until his death in 1840.
Cathrin Mayer is director.
The Vorstand is Jens Nowak (chair), Andreas Janßen (deputy chair), Timo Antons (treasurer), Annette Schütze, Dr.
Jens Nowak and Andreas Janßen, the chair and deputy chair, appear on it.

name: Kunsthalle Bremen
known: Directors: Gustav Pauli (1899 to 1914), Emil Waldmann (1914 to 1945), Günter Busch (1945 to 1984), Siegfried Salzmann (1985 to 1993), Wulf Herzogenrath (1994 to 2011) and Christoph Grunenberg (since November 2011).
Nicole Lamotte has chaired the Kunstverein since October 2020 (Wikipedia).

name: Villa Esche
known: Names C3's managing director and register number in its legal notice and lists the villa's sponsors;

name: Haus Ungers (Ungers Archiv für Architekturwissenschaft)
known: Stiftung UAA is a foundation under German civil law with its board of Sophia Ungers (managing chair), Dr Georg Thoma (deputy chair) and Anja Sieber-Albers (UAA legal notice, board page).

name: Kölnischer Kunstverein
known: Founder members included Eberhard von Groote (first president), Johann Maria Farina and Joseph Mathias de Noël.

Directors since 1913 named by the Kunstverein: Paul Cassirer (1913), Toni Feldenkirchen and Josef Haubrich (1942 to 1972), Wulf Herzogenrath (1973 to 1989), Marianne Stockebrand, Udo Kittelmann, Kathrin Rhomberg, Moritz Wesseler and Nikola Dietrich (2018 to 2023).
Thomas Waldschmidt (chair), Heike van den Valentyn (deputy chair), Ulrike Remde (treasurer), Christian DuMont Schütte (secretary) and six further members.
Wolfgang Strobel is honorary chair.

name: Museum Ludwig
known: Founded by a donation contract signed on 23 February 1976 by Peter and Irene Ludwig and the City of Cologne (museum website).
The director is Yilmaz Dziewior, who took over in February 2015 (Kaput interview, 2015).
